decisions.reason: As a newly launched core process machine with its own product page, it is likely still in the market-development phase and a medium-sized German machinery firm would usually give it more time before discontinuing it.

Although it appears close to product A and could face internal overlap, it is also newly launched and visibly marketed, so the firm would more likely retain it than withdraw it after only about a year.

An automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's coating-equipment portfolio well, and established machinery firms typically keep such adjacent products on the market unless early demand is clearly weak.
The manual airless spray gun is somewhat more exposed to price competition and portfolio rationalisation than larger equipment, but its recent launch still makes near-term withdrawal unlikely.
An air-assisted airless spray gun is a specialised extension of the firm's application technology range, so the firm would probably continue supporting it to build market acceptance.

A data logger complements coating equipment and supports digitalisation and service offerings, which makes it strategically attractive for a mature German machinery manufacturer to keep on the market.
